sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a canonical observation, case, or relationship term that can pair the qualifying ice concentration with its recorded distance.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the SPARQL branches that reject multiple distance or concentration QuantityValue nodes. The requirement requires a conforming threshold value and a recorded concentration-area distance, but does not declare uniqueness; the current != checks invent a cardinality restriction and can reject valid static graphs with multiple observations. Retain the conditional applicability, inclusive 12 nautical-mile threshold, required units and decimal datatypes, nearby concentration > 0.1, and recorded result existence.
